subject.title: fix(polls): add default maximum poll option count

question: For Matrix polls with more than 20 options, should OpenClaw truncate the poll, reject it with a clear caller-visible error, or preserve the existing passthrough behavior?
rationale: Each option changes what existing callers and end users observe; the builder cannot safely choose whether silently dropping poll choices is acceptable without Matrix ownership approval.

options.title: Confirm truncation with explicit feedback
options.body: Keep the 20-answer builder cap, but define and test how the caller or user is told that trailing options were removed.

options.title: Reject oversized polls
options.body: Preserve all-or-nothing poll semantics by returning a clear error before delivery when the poll has more than 20 options.

options.title: Keep current passthrough
options.body: Do not enforce a local cap until a supported Matrix interoperability policy and caller contract are agreed.

recommendation.title: Confirm truncation with explicit feedback
recommendation.body: Keep the 20-answer builder cap, but define and test how the caller or user is told that trailing options were removed.
